quote: We recruited four native English speakers as annotators. Annotators were trained and tested on a small set of instances in an online tutorial.
guideline: Your task is to rate the degree of topic relatedness between two texts in which a text sequence is used. ... The scale that you will be using for your judgments ranges from 1 (the two texts in a pair have completely unrelated topics) to 4 (the two texts in a pair have precisely identical topics).
